app.name: Parchment
dashboard.title: Operations Overview
dashboard.subtitle: A live snapshot of what Parchment has extracted, summarized, and de-duplicated.
dashboard.duplicatesHint: near-duplicate documents caught by embedding similarity
receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.subtitle: Upload a receipt photo, or try a synthetic sample — compare a classical OCR (Tesseract) + structuring pass against a local vision-language model reading the same image directly.
receipts.orSamples: or try a synthetic sample receipt
receipts.duplicateWarning: ⚠ This looks {pct}% similar to receipt #{id}, already processed.
pdfs.title: PDF Summarizer
pdfs.subtitle: Upload a PDF, or try the bundled sample (a real U.S. Federal Reserve report) — a local summarization model condenses it, and every number in the summary is cross-checked against the source text.
pdfs.useOpenRouter: Use OpenRouter (qwen/qwen3-8b) instead of the local summarizer
pdfs.scannedFallbackUsed: This looked like a scanned (image-only) PDF — text was recovered via page-image OCR instead of direct extraction.
pdfs.chunksTruncated: This document was long enough to split into {total} passages — {summarized} were sampled across its full length for this summary, to keep response time reasonable.
pdfs.duplicateWarning: ⚠ This looks {pct}% similar to PDF #{id}, already processed.
pdfs.numericCheckPassed: ✓ Every number in the summary was verified against the source text.
pdfs.numericCheckFailed: ⚠ Some numbers in the summary could not be verified against the source
tables.title: HTML Tables
tables.subtitle: Paste a URL with data tables, or try the sample page — tables are parsed with BeautifulSoup + pandas and can be exported as CSV.
library.title: Document Library
library.subtitle: Every processed document, embedded and checked against everything already on file — a duplicate-detection feature, not a search/RAG feature (see the guide for why that distinction matters).
library.empty: No documents processed yet — try the Receipts, PDF Summarizer, or HTML Tables tab.
admin.title: Admin Console
admin.subtitle: Users, audit trail, and live model/data status.
